method: Each set searched for Esper discard, graveyard and copy cards, then checked against EDHREC (main page and self-discard, reanimator and zombie themes), the most-viewed Bracket 3 Hashaton decks on Archidekt, and the most-liked and 23 most recently updated Bracket 2-3 Hashaton decks on Moxfield
summary: Hashaton copies every creature card you discard as a 4/4 Zombie for {2}{U}, and the copy keeps the card's abilities. So the best new cards are cheap ways to discard (looting, connive, landcycling creatures) and big creatures whose abilities are great on a 4/4 body. First pass: Secrets of Strixhaven and Marvel Super Heroes still have card search pages I couldn't read yet, so more ideas may come. The green badge means 3 or more community sources include the card; "Claude's pick" means I found it in the set but no Hashaton list uses it yet, which is where the less obvious ideas are.

picks.name: Avacyn, Angel of Horror
picks.why: Eight mana to cast, but you'll mostly discard it. For {2}{U} Hashaton gives you a 4/4 flying, deathtouch Avacyn that returns each of your nontoken creatures to the battlefield when it dies. Already one of the most-played new cards in Hashaton decks on EDHREC.

sources.label: Moxfield: 1 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Liliana the Faultless
picks.why: A one-mana repeatable discard outlet: {1}, tap, discard a card to give Hashaton or another creature hexproof. Protects your commander and feeds its trigger at the same time. Also gains life as creatures enter.
picks.cutWhy: Liliana does more work every turn

sources.label: Moxfield: 2 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Arni, Humble Scribe
picks.why: Three-mana looter with no activation cost: tap to draw then discard. It untaps whenever another nontoken creature enters, so a reanimation turn can loot several times.

picks.name: Divining Duelist
picks.why: Flash 3/2 that can loot when it enters. Instant-speed discard lets you hold up Hashaton mana on opponents' turns.

picks.name: Turbulent Shore
picks.why: Plains Island dual that enters untapped once opponents have eight lands. It has land types, so Stockman and Jennika's landcycling can find it, and it counts as an Island for Wonder. Shows up across every Hashaton list on EDHREC.

picks.name: Turbulent Wetlands
picks.why: The Island Swamp version of Turbulent Shore, with the same upsides.

sources.label: Moxfield: 2 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Darksteel Angel
picks.why: Nine mana, so it's discard fodder: Hashaton turns it into a 4/4 flying, indestructible Zombie that says you can't lose the game. Strong, but can feel oppressive at a Bracket 2 table.

sources.label: Archidekt: Hashaton's knockoff sweatshop (top viewed B3)
Moxfield: 3 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Murmuring Volume
picks.why: Three-mana rock that taps for any color and has {2}, tap, discard a card: draw a card. Ramp and a repeatable discard outlet in one slot.

picks.name: Occult Epiphany
picks.why: Instant: draw X, then discard X, and make a 1/1 flier for each card type you discarded. Lets you pitch several creatures at once for Hashaton at the end of an opponent's turn.

picks.name: Proft, Sinister Mastermind
picks.why: A creature you can discard for {B} as removal (-3/-1). Discarding it also triggers Hashaton, so you get the removal and a 4/4 Zombie copy.

picks.name: Rewrite Regrets
picks.why: Four-mana sorcery that returns a creature with mana value 6 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

picks.name: Sphinx of False Conclusions
picks.why: Flash flier that loots whenever it attacks, and makes a token copy of itself when it dies.

picks.name: The Echoverse Fulcrum
picks.why: Two-mana artifact that loots when it enters and can later be exiled for {5} to destroy all creatures. Your Zombie copies are tokens, so you rebuild fast.

picks.name: Seasoned Cryomancer
picks.why: Draws two and discards two when it enters, and taps and stuns an opposing creature whenever you discard a nonland card.

sources.label: Moxfield: 1 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

skipped.name: Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun
skipped.reason: Gives your spells split second; doesn't help a creature-discard plan.

picks.name: Wizard's Staff
picks.why: Equipment: if a triggered ability of the equipped creature triggers, it triggers an additional time. Equip Hashaton and every creature you discard can make two Zombie copies (you pay {2}{U} for each). It also doubles the enter triggers of your Zombie copies if you move it onto them.

sources.label: Moxfield: 1 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: The Queen of Dale
picks.why: Two-mana creature that loots whenever an opponent casts their first noncreature spell each turn, and makes a 1/1 when you discard a nonland card. Free discard on every opponent's turn.

sources.label: Moxfield: 3 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Bard, King of Dale
picks.why: Doubles your tokens and your extra card draw. Every Hashaton trigger makes two Zombie copies, and your loot effects draw double. Works as a 4/4 token copy too, so you can discard it and still get the effect.

sources.label: Moxfield: 8 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Captain of Umbar
picks.why: Three-mana creature with {1}, tap: draw then discard. A steady discard outlet every turn.

picks.name: Confusticate and Bebother
picks.why: Flexible instant: soft counter, or draw two and discard one. Covers interaction and a discard in one card.
picks.cutWhy: more flexible at the same job

sources.label: Moxfield: 1 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Along the Crooked Way
picks.why: Enchantment that returns a creature card from your graveyard to hand when it enters, so you can discard it again for another Hashaton copy.

picks.name: Thrór's Map
picks.why: Two-mana artifact that finds a basic land when it enters, then {2}, tap: draw then discard every turn. Cheap fixing plus a steady outlet.

picks.name: The Mountain-king's Return
picks.why: Saga: loot and make a token, then return a creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard, then a +1/+1 counter.

sets.name: Marvel Super Heroes

picks.name: A.I.M. Scientists
picks.why: Connives when it enters, and has basic landcycling {2}. Landcycling counts as discarding a creature card, so early it fetches a land and still triggers Hashaton.

picks.name: Daily Bugle Newspaper
picks.why: Two-mana artifact: {2}, tap to loot and make a Treasure. A discard outlet that also ramps, so it pays for Hashaton's {2}{U}.

sources.label: Moxfield: 1 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Doctor Jane Foster
picks.why: Returns a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard, to the battlefield if you gained life this turn (Liliana the Faultless and Gray Merchant help).

picks.name: M.O.D.O.K.
picks.why: Five-mana flying lifelinker: pay 3 life to connive (draw then discard) on your turn, as often as you like. A repeatable outlet that grows itself.

sets.name: Secrets of Strixhaven

picks.name: Turbulent Moor
picks.why: The Plains Swamp member of the Turbulent cycle (from the Strixhaven Commander decks). Same upsides as Turbulent Shore and Wetlands: fetchable with landcycling and untapped later in the game.

sources.label: Moxfield: 2 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Fix What's Broken
picks.why: Mass reanimation: pay X life to return every artifact and creature card with mana value exactly X. Good when you've discarded several big creatures of the same cost.

picks.name: Erode
picks.why: One-mana instant that destroys a creature or planeswalker; its controller may fetch a basic land. Another Swords to Plowshares-style answer, and it hits planeswalkers.

sources.label: Moxfield: 2 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

skipped.name: Forum Necroscribe
skipped.reason: Its reanimation needs spells that target creatures, which this deck has few of.

sets.note: Only the first of four search result pages could be read.

picks.name: Armaggon, Future Shark
picks.why: Eight mana with flash, so it's perfect discard fodder: for {2}{U} Hashaton makes a 4/4 Zombie copy whose enter trigger destroys up to three creatures. Cheap repeatable removal that only this commander can get.

sources.label: Moxfield: 3 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.cutWhy: Armaggon's removal is targeted and one-sided

picks.name: The Cloning of Shredder
picks.why: Saga that exiles a creature card from your graveyard and makes a token copy of it, then makes more copies on chapters II and III. Three copies of your best discarded creature for six mana.

picks.name: Stockman, Mad Fly-entist
picks.why: Islandcycling {2} on a creature: early game it finds a land and triggers Hashaton. Later it's a flyer that loots when it enters.
picks.cutWhy: Stockman fixes mana and feeds the commander

picks.name: Bebop, Warthog Warrior
picks.why: Swampcycling {2} creature with menace. Same idea as Stockman: a land early, a Hashaton trigger either way.

picks.name: Jennika, Bad Apple Big Sister
picks.why: Plainscycling {2} creature that makes a 2/2 when it enters. Another landcycler for the white side.

picks.name: Karai, Future of the Foot
picks.why: Orzhov 3-drop: combat damage returns a creature card from your graveyard to hand, or to the battlefield if it was sneaked in.

picks.name: Thirst for Identity
picks.why: Instant: draw three, then discard two unless you discard a creature card. In this deck you'll almost always discard one creature, which triggers Hashaton. Already showing up in Hashaton lists on EDHREC.

sources.label: Moxfield: 1 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Grave Venerations
picks.why: Makes you the monarch, returns a creature card from your graveyard to hand each end step while you stay monarch (so you can discard it again), and drains when your creatures die. Your 4/4 Zombies help keep the crown.

picks.name: Curious Colossus
picks.why: Seven mana, so you'll usually discard it: the 4/4 Zombie copy's enter trigger turns every creature one opponent controls into a 1/1 with no abilities.

sources.label: Moxfield: 1 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Iron-Shield Elf
picks.why: Two-mana creature with a free outlet: discard a card to give it indestructible. One of EDHREC's highest-lift cards for Hashaton and in several recent Moxfield lists. Overlaps with Trained Pronghorn, so it can replace it if you want a second free outlet.

sources.label: Moxfield: 4 of 23 recent Bracket 2-3 Hashaton lists

picks.name: Twilight Diviner
picks.why: Whenever creatures enter from your graveyard, makes a token copy of one of them. Pairs with Living Death, Sun Titan and Sister Hospitaller.

picks.name: Unexpected Assistance
picks.why: Convoke instant: draw three, discard one. Your Zombie tokens can pay for it.

skipped.name: Emptiness and Deceit
skipped.reason: Their enter abilities check what mana was spent, so a Hashaton token copy gets nothing.

skipped.name: Silvergill Peddler
skipped.reason: Only loots when tapped; weaker than the other looters.
